title: The customer is always right, even when the internet disagrees.
hook: When you correct one fact, no re-crawl should ever overwrite you again.
thesis: Every small business owner has lived this: you fix your hours somewhere and a fresh data pull resets them to the old wrong value. FYD gives owner corrections precedence over re-crawls, always. Correct X to Y, the system re-crawls, it stays Y. This was the P0 proof the directive demanded, and it is a pitch every owner instantly understands.

verified: Owner intent beats a fresh crawl, always (FYD ten-day directive architecture section, via SYSTEMS.md section 2).
Correction survival (correct X to Y, re-crawl, still Y) was the P0 proof in progress as of 2026-09-29 (SYSTEMS.md section 2).
inferred: This pain is universal among small business owners with inconsistent listings.
